name: realtime-avatar
longDescription: Realtime Avatar (RTA) brings live, interactive AI avatar video conversations to ChatGPT. Talk by voice or text, choose a conversation topic, and control your session from a single view. Powered by realtimeavatar.ai.
capabilities: Set up an avatar conversation with an optional topic
Start and end a live avatar video call
Return a session-completion message after an explicit user action
defaultPrompt: Open a video conversation with Realtime Avatar.
Talk through my product idea with an AI avatar.
Show me the available avatar on Realtime Avatar.
release_notes: Introduces the generic Realtime Avatar identity and live-video description. General conversation is the default, with an optional topic and additional conversation modes. Updates the package, tool labels, widget and public metadata. Existing review limits and account/usage disclosures continue to apply.
